title: Adult Primary Insomnia Polysomnographic Study (0928-004)(COMPLETED)
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to test the safety and effectiveness of the Investigational Drug on insomnia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patients with a diagnosis of primary insomnia and in good physical and mental health

Exclusion Criteria:

* Adult patients with other medical , neurological and sleep disorders
